{"id":1933979794,"question_id":4219,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1772302038,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1933979794/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Operations to Make Array Parity Alternating","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> makeParityAlternating(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n\n        vector<int>ans(2);\n        if(n == 1)\n        {\n            ans[0] = 0;\n            ans[1] = 0;\n            return ans;\n        }\n\n        int minoprs = INT_MAX;\n        int minval = INT_MAX;\n\n        for(int start = 0 ; start < 2 ; start++)\n        {\n            int oprs = 0;\n            vector<int>temp = nums;\n            int maxi = *max_element(temp.begin() , temp.end());\n            int mini = *min_element(temp.begin() , temp.end());\n\n            for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n            {\n                int ongoingparity = (i % 2 == 0) ? start : 1 - start;\n                if((abs(temp[i]) % 2) != ongoingparity)\n                {\n                    if(abs(temp[i] - maxi) < abs(temp[i] - mini))\n                    {\n                        temp[i]--;\n                    }\n                    else temp[i]++;\n                    oprs++;\n                }\n            }\n            int newmaxi = *max_element(temp.begin() , temp.end());\n            int newmini = *min_element(temp.begin() , temp.end());\n\n            if(oprs < minoprs)\n            {\n                minoprs = oprs;\n                minval = newmaxi - newmini;\n            }\n            else if(oprs == minoprs)\n            {\n                minval = min(minval , newmaxi - newmini);\n            }\n        }\n    ans[0] = minoprs;\n    ans[1] = minval;\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-operations-to-make-array-parity-alternating","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1754}
